result.instructions: Plan a chatmotion film before it is made. start_planning opens a plan from whatever the person brought: a script, a brief, notes, a link. Read it with describe_plan, fill it with the tools, and ask the person only what the material leaves open. Each write names where its answer came from, with words copied from that source; a write the words do not support, or one that changes what the person decided, is refused with the reason. Pass on what the person says next with tell. make_film starts the film the plan describes.
